measurement.comparison: The historical official Runta/Baseten baseline and local kuku observations come from different environments.
measurement.ordering: For each case, the first supplied attempt is first and each later attempt is a rerun.
measurement.official_scoring: Flagged passes score as failures. Infrastructure outcomes are excluded.
measurement.official_time: Agent plus verifier time, excluding queue wait, across scored attempts with timing.
measurement.official_cost: Mean inference USD from the official feed. Sandbox charges are excluded.
measurement.local_time: SDK execution inside the container and verifier wall times are measured separately.
measurement.local_performance: Proxy timing starts before the outbound connection. First output is the first nonempty text, reasoning or tool-argument delta. Stream TPS spans first output to stream end and uses reported completion tokens. OpenRouter receipt latency is the reported latency field. Provider-native TTFT is unavailable. Receipt TPS uses native completion tokens and generation duration. Matching delayed receipts can supplement provider timing and routing evidence.
measurement.local_cost: Completed OpenRouter stream usage or generation receipts provide known request charges. DeepSeek direct charges are estimated from token usage. Missing charges may be accounted at an upper bound. Partial reported amounts cover requests with a provider-reported cost.
measurement.local_usage: Token sums use available usage and may be incomplete. Reasoning tokens are part of output when reported. Cache hit rate divides cached input by input only on requests with both fields.
measurement.local_routing: The pin is request configuration. Reported providers and route matching come from response evidence. Unknown observations do not confirm a route or rule out fallback.
measurement.local_result: Task pass is the local runner result. Reward is the raw verifier score independently observed by the runner.
measurement.local_tools: Tool errors count tool.result status error. Non-ok results include blocked and canceled calls. Workspace script calls count model invocations. Host actions count the dispatched actions in script result receipts and are unknown if receipts are incomplete.
measurement.local_resources: Harness memory is in KiB. The mean is time-weighted over RSS samples. The peak is the largest available process RSS or high-water observation. End-of-run self usage is from getrusage(RUSAGE_SELF), with I/O in blocks. Process I/O is the last sample, including children already waited on. Its rchar and wchar count logical characters. The read_bytes and write_bytes fields count storage I/O bytes. Block I/O covers the entire container, including tools. Its byte values come from the latest valid retained Docker stats display and may be rounded or precede final writes. Sampling error counters track caught sampling exceptions. Earlier records combine the two samplers.
